{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any row where revenue_clean is exactly 999999.99
internal_test_rows = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

print("Number of internal test orders (numerically 999999.99):", len(internal_test_rows))
print("Sample of such rows:", internal_test_rows[['order_id', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean']].head().to_dict('records'))"}
